About Us

Learn more about Beacon Digital and our mission.

Welcome to Beacon Digital Agency

Beacon Digital Agency — your trusted partner in digital transformation and creative innovation. Founded by Olamilekan Amujosafe, Beacon Digital has been empowering businesses for over 5 years, delivering exceptional results across web development, branding, marketing, and design.

With a passionate team of 10+ skilled experts, we blend technology, creativity, and strategy to help brands grow and stand out. From startups to established enterprises, we’ve partnered with companies across industries, helping them unlock their full potential.

Our Mission

To help ambitious brands grow with smart technology, beautiful design, and serious creativity.

Why Choose Us?

  • ✅ 5+ Years of Proven Experience
  • ✅ 10+ Dedicated Professionals
  • ✅ Results-Driven Approach
  • ✅ Beautiful, User-Friendly Designs
  • ✅ Innovative Solutions Tailored to Your Needs

At Beacon Digital, your success is our priority. We don't just deliver projects — we build relationships.

Our Journey

2020: Foundation

Beacon Digital was founded by Olamilekan Amujosafe with a vision to revolutionize digital experiences through innovative technology and creative design.

2021: First Major Projects

Successfully delivered our first enterprise-level web applications and branding projects, establishing our reputation for quality and innovation.

2022: Team Expansion

Grew our talented team to 10+ experts, expanding our capabilities in UI/UX design, full-stack development, and digital marketing.

2023: Industry Recognition

Received multiple awards for outstanding digital solutions and client satisfaction, solidifying our position as a leading digital agency.

2024: Global Reach

Expanded our services internationally, partnering with clients across industries to deliver transformative digital experiences.

2025: Future Forward

Continuing to innovate with cutting-edge technologies like AI, VR, and advanced web solutions to stay ahead of digital trends.
